title: NIB Extras Change - Less Back from Dentist as Not Preferred Provider
body:
Which health insurance companies still allow you to choose a dentist that is outside of their network and not punish you for it by giving you lower rebates?
NIB have been great for me until they made their changes from 1 Oct 2026. They now give you a set benefit per dental item number if you are seeing a dentist that is outside of their network.
So I am getting far less back on dental and the policy doesn’t seem worth it. I do not wish to change dentists as mine is great, but are independent of any health insurers preferred providers lists.
I like to have my 6 monthly checkups with my dentist. Cost for check and clean is $240. Occasionally I get glasses - every couple of years or so. What extra covers would people recommend in similar position?
